observation_summary: The application throws a NullPointerException during chart rendering when the dataset contains null mean or standard deviation values.
reasoning_summary: The code fails when attempting to retrieve and use statistical values (mean and standard deviation) from a dataset that contains null entries. The renderer assumes these values are always present as non-null Numbers, leading to a NullPointerException when calling .doubleValue() on a null reference. The fix introduces explicit null checks before accessing these values, ensuring the renderer gracefully skips drawing bars or deviation lines when the data is missing.
